title: Squash risotto with chestnut chilli oil

source.title: Thomasina Miers' recipe for squash risotto with chestnut chilli oil

instructions: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the thickly sliced squash, skin on, with 2 tbsp olive oil, a third of the thyme leaves, salt and pepper. Roast for 30 minutes, until soft and golden at the edges.

For the chilli oil, deseed the chillies and snip into rings. Warm the sunflower oil in a small pan, turn to the lowest heat and add the chillies, garlic, half the remaining thyme and half the chestnuts. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes, until the garlic is pale golden. Blitz roughly in the pan with a stick blender, add the rest of the chestnuts and the chilli flakes, warm through, then take off the heat and stir in the lemon zest and juice.
Warm 3 tbsp olive oil in a wide pan, add the onion, season well, add the last of the thyme and sweat on medium-low for 7 to 8 minutes, until soft.
Turn up to medium, add the barley and stir until glossy. Add the wine and stir until absorbed, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed before the next.
After 10 minutes, scrape the squash from its skin and stir it in. Keep adding stock for about 20 minutes more, until the barley is tender with some bite.
Stir in the cheese and butter, season, and serve with the chilli oil on top and some parsley.
